stock.description: China Green Broad Ecological Technology Co. Ltd. functions as an investment holding entity, primarily dedicated to providing services in landscape architecture, horticulture, and associated fields. The company delivers comprehensive, end-to-end service offerings, which span from initial conceptualization and planning, through design refinement, construction, plant cultivation, and subsequent upkeep. This enterprise was established on October 22, 2013, by co-founders Zheng Ping Wu and Li Xiao, and its headquarters are situated in Shanghai, China.
